title: Health Care
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael is tasked with selecting a new health care plan for the office but initially misunderstands the options. After Jan corrects him and urges cost-saving, Michael delegates the responsibility to Dwight, who chooses a harsh plan cutting many benefits, upsetting the employees. Dwight justifies his decision with survivalist logic and claims superior health. The office reacts negatively, leading to conflicts including forged medical information submitted by employees, Dwight suspending health care coverage, and pranks such as Jim locking Dwight in his workspace. Michael attempts to boost morale with promises of a surprise and plans for a trip, but the nature and outcome of these remain uncertain. Dwight's management of the health care plan causes confidentiality concerns and discomfort among employees, and the episode ends with anticipation around Michael's big surprise and unresolved tensions regarding the health care plan.
